scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,customer,management "npm run dev -w @conecta/api" "npm run dev -w @conecta/customer-web" "npm run dev -w @conecta/management-web"
scripts.db:up:demo: docker compose --env-file dev.env -p conecta-demo --profile identity up -d --wait db mailpit
scripts.db:migrate:demo: docker compose --env-file dev.env -p conecta-demo run --rm flyway migrate
scripts.dev:demo: node --env-file=dev.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/index.js -k -n api,customer,management "npm run dev -w @conecta/api" "npm run dev -w @conecta/customer-web" "npm run dev -w @conecta/management-web"
scripts.db:clean:demo: npm run build -w @conecta/api && node --env-file=dev.env scripts/development-clean.mjs --development && npm run db:migrate:demo
